No specification document

fields.v: Skill extraction from trajectories (task-level / event-driven / skip) -> skill evolution with new or failed evidence -> maintenance (add / merge / drop) -> retrieval (dense similarity, all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and injection into the frozen coding agent prompt. Training: supervised warmup with GPT-5.4-mini teacher, then 3-stage GRPO curriculum with hybrid reward (rubric quality + alignment-gated execution improvement). Test time: two preparatory passes over the test set build and evolve the bank, then final evaluation

fields.v: Success = benchmark verifier pass rate (%) per task; the authors state no success threshold for a configuration and no cost criterion. Values EnvBench-Python / EnvBench-Java / SWE-Bench Verified / Terminal-Bench 2 / Avg pass rate; steps = avg reasoning steps on instances solved by all methods (Table 1). Agents: mini-SWE-agent (SWE, TB2), ReAct-style bash agent (EnvBench); agent versions not stated. Frozen policy Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: (1) No-skill (baseline): 6.98 / 27.10 / 57.33 / 25.88 / 29.32; steps 44.12. (2) Subtask memory (re-implementation) + GPT-5.4-mini: 9.30 / 32.71 / 61.33 / 30.59 / 33.48; steps 39.76. (3) Prompt skill mgmt + Qwen3.5-4B: 4.65 / 30.84 / 58.67 / 24.71 / 29.72; steps 39.08. (4) Prompt skill mgmt + GPT-5.4-mini: 11.63 / 36.45 / 64.67 / 28.24 / 35.25; steps 37.02. (5) SFT-CodeSkill + Qwen3.5-4B: 13.95 / 35.51 / 64.00 / 24.71 / 34.54; steps 38.04. (6) CodeSkill + Qwen3.5-4B: 18.60 / 38.32 / 68.00 / 36.47 / 40.35; steps 35.99. Frozen policy GPT-5.4-mini: (7) No-skill (baseline): 4.65 / 15.89 / 46.67 / 20.00 / 21.80; steps 9.64. (8) Subtask memory + GPT-5.4-mini: 9.30 / 25.23 / 52.67 / 22.35 / 27.39; steps 8.56. (9) Prompt skill mgmt + Qwen3.5-4B: 6.98 / 22.43 / 50.67 / 23.53 / 25.90; steps 8.12. (10) Prompt skill mgmt + GPT-5.4-mini: 9.30 / 24.30 / 56.67 / 21.18 / 27.86; steps 8.11. (11) SFT-CodeSkill: 6.98 / 23.36 / 54.67 / 23.53 / 27.14; steps 7.98. (12) CodeSkill: 13.95 / 27.10 / 56.00 / 29.41 / 31.62; steps 8.03. Lifecycle ablations, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B policy (Table 2; avg computed from the four values where the text gives none): (13) event-driven only (ablation): 16.28 / 32.71 / 62.00 / 29.41 / (35.10), 916 skills; (14) task-level only (ablation): 11.63 / 30.84 / 58.67 / 28.24 / (32.35), 336 skills; (15) extraction only (ablation): 13.95 / 41.12 / 64.67 / 31.76 / 37.88, 1,252 skills; (16) extraction + evolution (ablation): 18.60 / 39.25 / 67.33 / 32.94 / 39.53, 1,252 skills; full lifecycle = (6), 676 skills. Quality and cost for every configuration: no criterion stated by the authors. Training cost of CodeSkill (one-off): 4×H100, SFT ~20 h, RL ~210 h

fields.v: Tasks: held-out splits of SWE-Bench Verified and EnvBench, Terminal-Bench 2 out-of-distribution. Configurations: 6 methods x 2 frozen downstream policies + lifecycle ablations. Baseline: no-skill (same frozen policy, no prior-knowledge section). Held constant: downstream policy, agent wrapper per benchmark, retrieval procedure, prompts, decoding, operation space (for prompt-based baseline). Acceptance tests: benchmark verifiers. Repetitions: Not stated (apparently one evaluation run). Human intervention: none. Skill bank built from two passes over the test set, excluding skills derived from the current test instance

fields.v: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B policy: CodeSkill best on all four benchmark groups; avg 40.35 vs 29.32 no-skill (+11.03, ~37.6% relative) and vs 35.25 best baseline (+5.10, ~14.5%); fewest steps (35.99 vs 44.12). GPT-5.4-mini policy: avg 31.62 vs 21.80 (+9.82) and vs 27.86 (+3.76), but below prompt-based GPT-5.4-mini on SWE-Bench Verified (56.00 vs 56.67). Full lifecycle reduces bank 1,252 to 676 skills with higher pass rate. No significance tests
